Fit a line and name the over- and under-performers

Source: R/relations.R
plot_fit.Rd

Scatter with a fitted relationship ("lm", "loess" or a GAM) and its confidence band. Points are coloured by their residual, and the cases farthest above and below the fit are labelled, which is usually the story ("for his assist load, he barely turns it over").

Usage

plot_fit(
  data,
  x,
  y,
  label,
  method = c("lm", "loess", "gam"),
  n_label = 4,
  highlight = NULL,
  above_is_good = TRUE,
  xlab = x,
  ylab = y,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

x, y

Columns.

label

Column with names.

method

"lm", "loess" or "gam".

n_label

Number of cases to label on each side of the fit.

highlight

Extra names to label.

above_is_good

Is being above the line good (affects colours)?

xlab, ylab, title, subtitle, caption

Labels.

Value

A ggplot; the fitted model is in attr(p, "fit").
